newsitem.title: CHILE: Escondida has no comment on strike vote.
newsitem.headline: Escondida has no comment on strike vote.

text.p: Minera Escondida Limitada has not received any official notification from its workers' union of the lifting of a two-week-old strike, a company spokesman said.
The spokesman said Escondida, owned by Broken Hill Proprietary, learned of the lifting of the strike through journalists and had not received any official notification.
"We will not have any official reaction to this until we receive notification from the union, and that has not happened yet," said the spokesman, who asked not to be identified.

A union spokesman said earlier that the mine's some-350 striking workers, out of a total workforce of about 2,000, had voted to lift the strike and return to the job. Escondida management has said publicly the strike had no effect on production.
